test_title: PYST 28: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 18 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

He saved money each month __in case of afford a new car.__

options.text: in the mean time afford new car
in order to afford a new car
in addition to afford the new car
in charge of affording new car

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "in case of afford a new car" is grammatically incorrect and does not convey the intended meaning.
 
• The correct phrase is "**in order to afford a new car**," which indicates the purpose of saving money.
 
• The use of "in order to" shows the goal or reason behind the action of saving money each month.
 
• Option 2 is the most appropriate substitution, ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He saved money each month in order to afford a new car.__"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "in the mean time afford new car"** – This is incorrect as it does not fit the context and lacks grammatical correctness.
 
• **Option 3: "in addition to afford the new car"** – This is incorrect as it implies an additional action rather than a purpose.
 
• **Option 4: "in charge of affording new car"** – This is incorrect as it conveys a completely different meaning and is not relevant to the context.
